scoring.description: Starts at 5.0 (neutral). Adjustments are applied for rate fairness, deliverable effort, usage rights, red flags, and value-add structures. Final score is clamped to [1, 10].

base_rates.description: USD per sponsored deliverable, by follower tier. Source: 2026 market surveys across IG/TT/YT.

deliverable_multipliers.description: Applied to base rate to determine expected compensation for effort level. Reference: static Instagram feed post = 1.0x.

instagram_story_set.label: Instagram Stories (3–5 frames)
instagram_story_set.note: Often bundled; rate should be 40% of a feed post

instagram_reel.label: Instagram Reel
instagram_reel.note: High production effort. Score penalised if rate not adjusted accordingly.

youtube_integration.label: YouTube Long-form Integration
youtube_integration.note: Requires scripting, editing, high production time.

live_qa.label: Live Q&A / Live Stream
live_qa.note: Premium effort: real-time, no editing control, high reputational risk.
live_qa.retainer_exception_note: Score modifier is waived if part of a monthly retainer deal (retainer bonus offsets this).

ugc_only.label: UGC (User Generated Content, not posted)
ugc_only.note: Creator produces but doesn't post. Brand pays for content creation only.

usage_rights.description: Percentage premium added on top of base content fee. Score modifier reflects fairness of compensation for rights granted.

perpetual.label: Perpetual / In Perpetuity
perpetual.recommendation: Advise creator to refuse unless paid 100–150% premium over base.

exclusivity.description: Monthly exclusivity premiums. Excessive exclusivity is a red flag.

whitelisting_paid_ads.description: Charged on top of content creation fee. 30% per month is the 2026 market standard.
whitelisting_paid_ads.note: Whitelisting grants brand run-of-network ad rights using the creator's handle. Must be compensated separately.

engagement_multipliers.description: Applied as a modifier to expected compensation tier.

niche_multipliers.description: Certain niches command premium rates due to audience intent and CPM value.

value_add_bonuses.description: Positive deal structures that increase score. A deal cannot reach 9–10 without at least one value-add.

monthly_retainer.label: Monthly Retainer Structure
monthly_retainer.condition: Deal includes a recurring monthly payment over 2+ months.
monthly_retainer.reasoning: Stable income, brand commitment, reduced admin overhead. 54% of brands use retainers in 2026.

affiliate_commission.label: Affiliate / Revenue Share Commission
affiliate_commission.condition: Deal includes a percentage commission on sales driven by creator.
affiliate_commission.reasoning: Upside participation, aligns incentives, recognises creator's conversion power.

performance_bonus.label: Performance Bonus / KPI Bonus
performance_bonus.condition: Deal includes bonus payment triggered by hitting engagement or reach targets.
performance_bonus.reasoning: Rewards creator for over-delivery. Positive alignment signal.

content_approval_rights.label: Creator Content Approval Rights
content_approval_rights.condition: Contract explicitly grants creator final approval or veto on edits.
content_approval_rights.reasoning: Protects brand safety and creative integrity.

kill_fee_clause.label: Kill Fee / Cancellation Protection
kill_fee_clause.condition: Contract includes a kill fee (typically 25–50% of deal value) if brand cancels.
kill_fee_clause.reasoning: Protects creator from last-minute cancellations that waste their time.

ip_retention.label: Creator Retains IP / Copyright
ip_retention.condition: Creator retains copyright and IP of content produced.

risk_penalties.description: Hard deductions applied when red flag clauses are detected. These override value-add bonuses.

ai_likeness_training.label: AI / ML Likeness Training Rights
ai_likeness_training.reasoning: Authorises brand to replicate creator's voice and face via AI without ongoing consent or compensation. Criminalised in several US states (Tennessee ELVIS Act, 2026).
ai_likeness_training.negotiation: Refuse unless compensated with a separate one-time licensing fee equivalent to 50–100% of the total deal value.

perpetuity_clause.label: Perpetual Rights / 'In Perpetuity'
perpetuity_clause.reasoning: Brand can use content indefinitely for any purpose at no additional cost. Creator loses all future licensing leverage.
perpetuity_clause.negotiation: Counter with 12-month maximum with renewal option at 50% of original rate.

total_buyout.label: Total Buyout / Full Rights Transfer
total_buyout.reasoning: Creator forfeits all copyright and future revenue from the content. Creators earning royalties make 40% more annually than buyout-only creators (2026 data).
total_buyout.negotiation: Require 100–300% premium over standard rate, or retain rights with 12-month license.

sublicensable.label: Sublicensable Rights
sublicensable.reasoning: Brand can sell or license creator's content to third parties — including competitors — without creator knowledge or additional payment.

excessive_exclusivity.label: Excessive Exclusivity (6+ months unpaid)
excessive_exclusivity.reasoning: Long exclusivity windows significantly restrict creator's income without equivalent compensation.

undefined_usage_channels.label: Undefined / Unlimited Usage Channels
undefined_usage_channels.reasoning: Gives brand unlimited distribution rights across TV, OOH, web, and paid ads without specifying or compensating for each use case.

no_content_removal.label: No Content Removal Rights
no_content_removal.reasoning: Creator cannot remove content even if their values or personal brand evolve.

scoring_algorithm.description: Step-by-step scoring logic for the AI to follow.
steps: 2. Determine creator tier (nano/micro/mid_tier) from follower count if provided.
3. Extract the offered rate from the email. Compare to tier's per_post_typical. Apply rate score_weight based on where offer falls relative to min/typical/max.
4. Identify deliverable type(s). Apply deliverable score_modifier for each. If Live Q&A is included AND monthly_retainer is also present, waive the live_qa penalty.
5. Identify usage rights duration. Apply score_modifier_if_paid or score_modifier_if_unpaid based on whether the contract compensates for them.
6. Identify exclusivity terms. Apply corresponding score modifier.
7. Identify whitelisting/paid ads. Apply modifier if uncompensated.
8. Apply engagement_multiplier bonus if creator profile includes engagement rate.
9. Apply niche_multiplier score_bonus if niche is known.
10. Scan for value_add_bonuses (retainer, commission, performance bonus, IP retention, kill fee). Apply each bonus found.
11. Scan for risk_penalties. Apply each penalty found. Penalties stack and are NOT capped.
12. A score of 9–10 requires: rate at or above typical for tier AND at least one value_add_bonus AND zero critical risk penalties.
13. Clamp final score to [1.0, 10.0]. Round to nearest 0.5 for display.
14. Return score_breakdown array listing each adjustment with label and value.
